summary: Electrovaya Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq and TSX, furnished a Form 6-K with a press release announcing management's participation in four investor conferences: Craig-Hallum Alpha Select (Nov 17, 2026), ROTH Technology (Nov 18, 2026), UBS Global Industrials Transportation (Dec 2-3, 2026), and Bernstein Insights Industrials Energy Forum (Dec 8, 2026), each in 1x1 or fireside format. No transaction, capital event, or governance change is disclosed; the release is a routine investor-relations calendar notice. No terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated. Watch for any subsequent offering or strategic announcement referenced obliquely in boilerplate.
